purpose: Screen three mechanistically distinct NSESche profiles that reproduce FaaSRank's native parent-complete request/DAG order and deterministic exploitation initialization, while allowing no move or only result-blind strict-Pareto Nash moves.

frozen_comparator.source_experiment: V70 E2 homogeneous n100 low scale5 E380-E389 paired screen
frozen_comparator.cross_cohort_limitation: E410-E419 are not exchangeable paired replications of E380-E389. Passing this screen is only permission to run an untouched paired confirmation; it is not evidence that NSESche beats a baseline.

mechanistic_diagnosis.V70_failure: The V70 Borda candidates remained below the paired FaaSRank threshold for throughput and both QPR definitions.
native_FaaSRank_properties: iterate requests in the simulator's native request-map order
collect only parent-complete tasks in each DAG's native traversal order
rank by frozen projected-node-load FaaSRank exploitation score
mechanistic_diagnosis.prior_NSESche_gap: Earlier faithful-score profiles sorted players by canonical PlayerId and then allowed the Nash inner loop to overwrite the FaaSRank initialization.
mechanistic_diagnosis.V71_change: Preserve native request/DAG collection order, use deterministic exploitation without epsilon exploration, and constrain later Nash moves using a preregistered result-blind guard.

candidates.definition: Keep the native FaaSRank initialization unchanged through the online Nash coordination stage.
Permit a Nash move only when paper utility and frozen FaaSRank score both strictly improve.
Permit a Nash move only when paper utility and the preregistered online completion proxy strictly improve while frozen FaaSRank score does not worsen.

result_blind_execution_order: Commit and push the implementation and this plan before generating any E410-E419 run spec or tape.
Build the release binary once, record its SHA-256 and runtime identity, then freeze a runtime receipt before inputs.
Capture ten fresh base tapes once and derive ten scale5 tapes; bind the same per-seed tape hash to all three candidates.
Bind the already frozen FaaSRank model without retraining or selection.
Build all thirty candidate-specific references with attempt-one and zero-quarantine gates before any online run.
Run all thirty candidate processes strictly serially; require exact joint coverage, attempt-one QC, zero quarantine, pairing, tape identity and runtime identity.
Read throughput and QPR exactly once only after the complete joint audit passes.

analysis.throughput: Arithmetic mean fixed-window throughput across all ten development seeds.
analysis.qpr_finite_only: Arithmetic mean per-run throughput/(latency*cost) across finite runs.
analysis.qpr_zero_completed_as_zero: Same QPR with zero-completion runs contributing zero over all ten seeds.
analysis.development_thresholds: The three immutable V70 paired FaaSRank means recorded above.
analysis.candidate_gate: Strictly exceed 6.922 throughput, 0.21230153185827091 finite-only QPR and 0.21230153185827091 zero-as-zero QPR; ties fail.
analysis.selection_rule: Among passing candidates, maximize the minimum relative margin over the three frozen thresholds; exact ties follow listed candidate order.
analysis.uncertainty: Report seed-level values and BCa confidence intervals without using them to relax the strict mean gate.
analysis.success_action: Freeze exactly one profile and separately preregister a paired confirmation on untouched E390-E409 tapes. The confirmation must include the frozen comparator set required for a same-cohort paper claim and the selected NSESche profile; no confirmation input may be generated before that plan is committed.
analysis.failure_action: Retain every E410-E419 artifact, mark all three candidates failed, and require a newly preregistered NSESche-only mechanism on seeds after E419.
